claim.text: A redaction save that flattened at least one region, whose saved document still holds a structure tree (a /StructTreeRoot the catalog holds, or any /StructParents or /StructParent entry) or any dictionary with the shape of a structure element (/Type /StructElem or /StructTreeRoot; /S a name with /P and any of /Alt /ActualText /E /T /Lang /A /C /ID /Ref /AF /Phoneme /PhoneticAlphabet; an /SE entry) - reachable from the catalog under any key, or a member of an object stream the saved file holds as a stream - reads region_flattened false, region_cleared false and is_proven false: the rules add 1 to residual_in_region once (however many of them hold) and NotProven::ResidualInRegion to the reasons. A save with no region applies none of these rules. The redaction proof covers untagged documents, and documents whose caller removed every structure-element dictionary the saved file would still hold. A dictionary with /S and a text key but no /P and no /Type /StructElem is not read as an element (residual).

rule.where: crates/hsk-studio-press/src/flatten_purge.rs: structure_shaped, Scan::value, Scan::object_stream, check_document; called once from sanitized_save.rs redact_and_save_with with `!flattened.is_empty()`
rule.one_count: tree (catalog /StructTreeRoot), /StructParents or /StructParent, and the shape rule share ONE flag: residual_in_region + 1 once. Alternative (a second +1) would turn the three R21 assertions 'residual exactly 1' (structure_and_widgets_of_flattened_pages_are_removed, flattened_page_annotations_leave_and_structure_elements_stay, direct_structure_tree_on_kept_pages_is_reported_too) into 2 because every tagged fixture also holds elements
rule.shape: /Type is the name StructElem or StructTreeRoot (value followed through references); OR /S is a name (followed through references) and /P is held (not null) and any key of STRUCT_TEXT_KEYS is held; OR /SE is held (not null). Keys are the parsed dictionary's (names decoded), so /Struct#45lem, /#54ype and /S#45 count and a comment, a string or another case do not
rule.j2a_count: J2a (R24): residual 2, not 1: the existing /Pg scan counts the element whose /Pg is the flattened page (1, as before) and the shape rule adds its one count; region_flattened false, reasons [ResidualInRegion] as before
rule.scope: PLR-101: check_document(saved, flat_pages, flattens); tree, parents and shape rules need flattens; the XFA/NeedsRendering/Pg/P checks and the depth guard run for every save as before (with no region only the XFA/NeedsRendering and depth guard can fire; strip_xfa has already run)
rule.object_streams: an object stream that a kept object references stays in the saved file as a stream whose members no xref entry names (R24 K1); the scan decodes it (filters::decode_stream against a budget of max_decoded_total), reads N and First, then one header pair and member at a time (parse_standalone with max_depth and the node meter max_nodes), parsed bytes bounded by the decoded size; a stream that cannot be decoded or parsed counts (fail closed)
